text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! You're really good at claw machines, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If I follow your example and think more about where the claw is going to grab, then… Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, now it's my turn to get that stuffed spider. Just you watch!
